comparison.objective: Lower a hoisted motor onto four base studs while operating the hoist and steering the suspended load.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinate pendant control with pendulum-load alignment, multi-stud insertion, and pinch avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: All four studs pass through flat feet, chain is slack, load is stable, controls released, with no strike or unsafe body entry.
comparison.reason: Although both require bimanual alignment and insertion, the benchmark tests suspended-load steering onto four studs. It does not test a flush sliding bridge, uninterrupted raceway support, or loss-prone free balls.
